Writer.title: Writer
Writer.description: An approved blog writer invited by the portfolio owner. Stored in an isolated collection because it holds the writer's email address (PII).

email.description: Lowercase Google account email address authorized to sign in and publish articles.

displayName.description: Public byline name displayed on articles written by this author.

role.description: Access level granted to this author.

title.description: Short editorial title shown beneath the author's name (e.g., Guest Writer, Product Designer).

bio.description: Short writer biography shown on article footers.

status.description: Whether this writer currently has active publishing permissions.

addedByUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner who added this writer.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the writer invitation was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the writer record was last updated.

BlogPost.title: BlogPost
BlogPost.description: A rich-format Medium-style editorial article stored in Firestore. Publicly readable when status is published; drafts are private to the author and owner.

slug.description: URL-friendly slug identifier for the article.

subtitle.description: Optional sub-headline or deck displayed under the title.

excerpt.description: Short preview summary displayed on the blog index.

coverImage.description: HTTPS URL or compressed data URL for the article cover image.

coverAlt.description: Accessible alt text for the cover image.

tags.description: Up to 6 concise topic tags for the article.

blocks.description: Ordered list of rich editorial content blocks (paragraphs, headings, images, quotes, links, attachments, dividers, code).

authorUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the author who created the post.

authorName.description: Public byline name of the author.

authorRole.description: Short role label shown beside the author name.

authorPhotoUrl.description: Optional public avatar URL for the author.

readTimeMinutes.description: Estimated reading time in minutes (1 to 120).

publishedAt.description: Server timestamp when the article was published, or null while in draft.

createdAt.description: Immutable server timestamp when the article was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the article was last modified.

Inquiry.title: Inquiry
Inquiry.description: A prospective client or print inquiry submitted through the portfolio contact form. Write-only for public visitors and readable strictly by the portfolio owner (PII-isolated).

subject.description: Formatted subject line showing topic and sender name.

message.description: Plain-text project brief or inquiry message.

emailDelivered.description: Whether direct Gmail SMTP delivery succeeded for this inquiry.

status.description: Owner triage status for the inquiry backup.

createdAt.description: Immutable server timestamp when the inquiry was received.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the inquiry status was last updated.

/writers/{writerId}.description: Invited writer access registry (PII-isolated: readable only by owner/admin or the matching verified writer).

/posts/{postId}.description: Blog articles collection. Published posts are publicly readable; drafts are restricted to their author and the owner.

/inquiries/{inquiryId}.description: Client inquiry backups submitted from Get in Touch and Buy Image forms. Public create with strict schema validation; get/list/update/delete strictly restricted to the verified owner.
